reviews.t: Great body and hair oil, great for eczema!
reviews.x: Love this Product!!!! I used to purchase this product from a local health food shop and they quit carrying it. It took me some time to locate it on amazon, but so happy I did.  The fragrance is awesome! it has a tropical smell mixed with a floral smell.  It is a blend of natural essential oils in amond oil, jahoba oil, and olive oil base.  I have eczema and this is the only thing that prevents a break out in the winters. It is a heavier oil but I use it in the shower and towel it off.  It is als

I've tried every body oil out there and this is my favorite by far.  I use it in the shower on my legs and arms every day.  It's got a lovely scent and goes on light and silky.  I also put it on my face as a night treatment - it's light enough.  It's a good natural oil for allover use.  I've tried it on my hair as an oil treatment and it worked well.

reviews.t: This product has gentle, intense healing properties.
reviews.x: My skin is changing. I am 60 years old, with mediterranean - native american origin, so I am not used to this change. My skin on my face was dry in certain areas, my whole body had skin that was dry. But this oil works wonders! I love it! With regular use, it has transformed my skin back to normal. Also my water consumption increased .

reviews.t: I really liked it at first!
reviews.x: There is no doubt that most of these oils/ingredients are extremely beneficial and have made my skin soft without being overly oily. But one ingredient, DiMethicone, isn't quite so natural. It is something added to help make the oils more spreadable across the skin and something that often leaves a thin layer of build up, almost has a plastic feel. reviews.t: Use in shower after cleaning yourself hair and body.
reviews.x: Makes your skin and hair glow. I recommend applying it to your hair and all over your skin in the shower after you clean your whole body. Then rinse for a few minutes with hot water. Then tap dry after you get out. You will see a wonderful natural glow for the next couple days...

I like the oil much better than any lotion or oil I ever used. I usually use coconut oil or Shea butter but this has such a smooth easy finish and a light scent everyone that has tried it has bought it or complimented it. Also I use it on my kids
We love this stuff for massages! This is the fourth time we have purchased it. The bottle last a long time. Pleasant, not perfumy scent.

In his final years my father developed awful, itchy, scaly, flaking skin - everywhere on his body. It was torture for him. In his final year a massage therapist recommended this oil and it absolutely changed his life. At first we applied it several times a day and after less than a month his skin was like a baby's. We used it everywhere, even his scalp and ears. Absolutely perfect. Thank you for carrying it.

reviews.t: A good body and hair oil
reviews.x: A great oil blend for many body and hair uses. And the scent is mild. I can't use strong scents/synthetic fragrances, etc.

I recently had my first massage (loved it!) and was introduced to Seven Wonders. The smell is wonderful and very relaxing. I use it at night, especially in the summer for dry skin. Use just a little, it goes a long way.

reviews.t: I find it works best if you dry skin brush and shower before use
reviews.x: I have used this oil for quite awhile.  Probably bought this oil 10 times now.  I find it works best if you dry skin brush and shower before use.  Using natural products like from uncle harrys and a decent shower filter, you will feel amazing after your shower.  It has a very pleasant scent and a little goes a long way.  Well I still use a little more anyways cause there's no harm in it.  I find it works best on wet skin so I use it right out of the shower.  Will continue to purchase this!

Skip the lotion - use this oil after showering while your body is still damp with moisture - and you will have the smoothest possible skin you could ask for. It smells AMAZING (much like a vanilla/lavendar blend) and applies very smoothly. I swear by the Miracle Oil!

Most amazing oil I have ever found. I am in love with it. I put it everywhere and each time I fall more and more in love.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant, mild scent, describing it as tropical, floral, vanilla/lavender, or not perfumy.
Many reviewers report soft, smooth, glowing skin and say it works well for dry skin and even eczema.
Reviewers commonly use it as a multi-purpose oil for body, hair, face, massage, and makeup removal.
Several reviewers are repeat purchasers who find the bottle lasts a long time and consider it good value.
One reviewer objects that the ingredient Dimethicone is not natural, despite liking the product initially.
